The structure of composition Mg8Sb4Te4 (reduced formula Mg2SbTe) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group Cm (No. 8), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over seven independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived CrystalNN analysis identifies Mg centers with 12 geometric neighbors (8 Mg, 4 Te or 1 Te, 3 Sb) across three orbits, while Sb adopts 9- and 10-neighbor environments and Te shows 8- and 10-neighbor environments. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3D-connected component, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Mg 12-vertex and Te 10-vertex polyhedra.
